kjv_def: bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away
strongs_def: to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively)
it_def:
1) transitivamente
   1a) inclinare
   1b) far cadere indietro, mettere in fuga
   1c) reclinare
      1c1) in capo per riposare
2) intransitivamente
   2a) inclinarsi
      2a1) del declinare del giorno, tramontare
